base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689839/attempts/999ba5f7203e4d1c9459d496b4c7cec5/system/state/workspace/programs')

src='''def transform(grid):
    """Extend the center row and column of each solid 3x3 color block."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    lines = [[set() for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    blocks = []
    for r in range(h - 2):
        for c in range(w - 2):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color != 0 and all(grid[rr][cc] == color
                                  for rr in range(r, r + 3)
                                  for cc in range(c, c + 3)):
                blocks.append((r + 1, c + 1, color))
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for cr, cc, color in blocks:
        for c in range(w):
            lines[cr][c].add(color)
        for r in range(h):
            lines[r][cc].add(color)
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if lines[r][c]:
                out[r][c] = next(iter(lines[r][c])) if len(lines[r][c]) == 1 else 0
    return out
'''
